jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.summary: Train and ship perception models for warehouse robots; own the data pipeline end to end.
jobs.raw_text: Sakura Robotics (Shinagawa, Tokyo) is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to build perception models for autonomous warehouse robots. You will train and deploy PyTorch models, own the labeling and data pipeline, and work with the robotics team on-site. Requirements: 3+ years applied ML, strong Python/PyTorch, experience deploying models (MLOps). Nice to have: Japanese N2, Kubernetes. Hybrid, 3 days on-site. ¥9M–¥14M.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, Recommendation
jobs.summary: Lead the home-feed recommender for a 20M-user marketplace; remote within Japan.
jobs.raw_text: Senior ML Engineer for the recommendation team of a large C2C marketplace in Tokyo. Own ranking and retrieval for the home feed (two-tower retrieval, GBDT ranking, online A/B). Requirements: 5+ years ML in production, Python, Spark/SQL at scale, recommender systems. English-speaking team; remote anywhere in Japan. ¥12M–¥18M plus RSU.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, NLP
jobs.summary: LLM-based note summarisation for elder-care providers; Osaka or remote.
jobs.raw_text: Kaigo AI builds LLM tools for elder-care providers. As an Applied Scientist (NLP) you will fine-tune and evaluate Japanese-language models for care-note summarisation and structured extraction. Requirements: 2+ years NLP, transformers, Python, evaluation design. Japanese reading ability a plus. Remote-first, Osaka office optional. ¥8M–¥12M.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Go)

jobs.raw_text: Nimbus Payments is hiring a Backend Engineer (Go) for its payments core: ledger, settlement and risk services in Go with PostgreSQL and gRPC. 3+ years backend experience, Go in production, solid SQL. Kubernetes and fintech experience welcome. Hybrid, Marunouchi. ¥8M–¥11M.

jobs.title: iOS Engineer

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.summary: Demand forecasting and promotion analysis for 400 stores.
jobs.raw_text: Data Scientist for a retail analytics team in Nagoya: demand forecasting, promotion uplift analysis, dashboards for 400 stores. Python, SQL, applied statistics; causal inference and Tableau a plus. On-site, Nagoya. ¥6.5M–¥9M.

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer

jobs.raw_text: MLOps Engineer to build and run the training and serving platform for Sakura Robotics' ML team on GCP: Kubernetes, Vertex AI, CI/CD for models, Terraform. 3+ years infra or platform experience with Python. Hybrid, Tokyo. ¥8M–¥12M.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (React)

jobs.raw_text: Frontend Engineer for Nimbus Payments' merchant dashboard (React, TypeScript, Next.js). 3+ years frontend experience, strong TypeScript, an eye for design systems. Remote within Japan. ¥7M–¥10M.

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer

jobs.raw_text: Computer Vision Engineer for inspection drones: detection and tracking models deployed on edge hardware (Jetson). PyTorch, C++, model optimisation; ROS a plus. On-site in Tsukuba. ¥7M–¥11M.

jobs.raw_text: Junior Machine Learning Engineer, Tokyo. Build and maintain forecasting models with a senior mentor; Python, scikit-learn, SQL. New graduates and career changers with a portfolio welcome. On-site, Tokyo. ¥5M–¥7M.
